name: live_mcp_capabilities
description:
Inspect local MCP tools and command schemas without connecting to KiCad.

This inventory describes the loaded adapter, not negotiated support in a live
editor. Document availability, command support and undo behavior still depend
on the connected KiCad version and editor.

name: live_schematic_documents
description: List open live schematic documents and KiCad version. Requires development KiCad 10.99/11+.

name: live_schematic_hierarchy
description: Read the live hierarchy, including unsaved child sheets. Use UUID sheet paths to target instances.

name: live_schematic_items
description:
Read unsaved items on one sheet as protobuf JSON. Positions are nanometers (1 mm = 1000000 nm).

Preserve the returned @type and all fields when updating an item. SheetSymbol includes its pins.

name: live_document_revision
description:
Read an open document's live revision (schematic, board, symbol or footprint document).

The editor advances it on every change: manual edits, API edits, undo/redo, reloads. Pass it as
expected_revision to an edit so KiCad refuses the edit if anything changed in between. Also
reports open API commits (from any client) and unsaved changes.

name: live_operation_status
description:
After a timed-out or uncertain edit: ask KiCad what happened to it. Never resends anything.

state: OPS_COMMITTED, OPS_ROLLED_BACK (dropped, conflicting or abandoned; nothing applied),
OPS_REJECTED (refused before changing anything), OPS_IN_PROGRESS (its commit is still open;
ask again), OPS_FAILED (an error after it may have changed the document; inspect it) or
OPS_UNKNOWN (not received yet, or older than the last history_capacity operations).
Do not resend an edit while its outcome is unknown.

name: live_schematic_create_items
description:
Create up to 200 items in the live editor as one undo step, without saving.

Each item is protobuf JSON with @type=type.googleapis.com/kiapi.schematic.types.TYPE.
Types include SchematicLine, HierarchicalLabel, Junction, SheetSymbol and SchematicText.
Use live_schematic_item_schema for field definitions. Coordinates are nanometers.
New sheets need a unique filename_field, name_field, size, position and page_number;
set visible=true on name_field and filename_field (otherwise the sheet is drawn unlabeled)
and fields_autoplaced=true so KiCad positions them at the sheet border.
Pins belong in SheetSymbol.pins, positioned on the sheet edge given by side.
Use live_schematic_place_symbol for library symbols.

name: live_pcb_documents
description: List boards open in the PCB editor (board documents for the live_pcb_* tools).
